name: GitHub — hosted MCP server
description: GitHub's own hosted MCP server, over OAuth. Not the same thing as the built-in `github-mcp` connector, which launches github/github-mcp-server as a local stdio process and therefore cannot act as more than one person.

hosts.why: The MCP server itself. Every tool call this connector brokers is dialled here.
The OAuth token endpoint. Dialled server-side, carrying this deployment's client secret, on every code exchange and refresh.

connector.description: GitHub, over the hosted MCP server

repo.name: Full access to repositories
repo.description: Read and write code, issues, pull requests and settings in every repository you can reach — private ones included. GitHub does not offer a read-only variant of this scope that still covers private repositories.

read:org.name: Read organisation membership
read:org.description: See which organisations and teams you belong to. Reads nothing inside a repository.
